review_evidence: README identifies a Lean 4 Chomsky-hierarchy formalization related to the published Lean 3 development.
Inspection found 19 Lean files with language operations and numerous list lemmas/definitions, including bijemap/permutation operations and flatten/take/drop properties.
The reviewed tree contains no test/generated/maintenance subtree that can be removed without losing formal constructions.
summary: Retain Chomsky completely: the repository formalizes the Chomsky hierarchy and supporting language/list constructions.
